tests.rival_result: A script-sensitive cost model predicts the same niches. The revised account retains that rival and only rejects the categorical all-task/impossibility rule.
tests.surviving_inference: Niche coexistence; no unique relative causal weights.
tests.limits: Shared historical observations/calibration; no independent printing cost reconstruction.

tests.topic: Interaction versus package effects and clinical endpoints
tests.rival_result: Additive/package alternatives are now separated from interaction. Supported HAPIN use with a specified clinical null prevents low use from explaining every null.
tests.surviving_inference: A scale-specific conditional mortality interaction and two separately bounded package/outcome studies.
tests.limits: No component randomization or original-data replication. High adherence does not prove zero birth-weight effect or settle residual exposure/timing.

tests.topic: Behavioural offers, dose returns and summary interpretation
tests.rival_result: Liquidity, calculation, credibility and heterogeneous returns remain realistic. The revised claims do not identify latent motives or generalize a contract ranking.
tests.surviving_inference: Local measured effects and dosage-specific calculated returns; no persistence or universal motive claim.
tests.limits: PSY-K07 was screened but not source-audited. Suri is an adaptive additional original, not a matched experimental replication or preregistered source.

tests.topic: PV cost models, knowledge and local adoption
tests.rival_result: Model equations and reconstructed inputs change allocated shares; output selection and imported machinery/training remain plausible.
tests.surviving_inference: Bounded accounting comparisons and production/adoption separation.
tests.limits: No model re-estimation, causal policy-share estimate, complete failed-firm denominator or modern Chinese market claim.

tests.topic: TEA contact, strict precision and material failures
tests.rival_result: Configuration differences predict the cross-lab contrast; the synthesis mostly preserves this but compresses counterexamples into unsupported logical directions.
tests.surviving_inference: Failed contacts refute contact sufficiency; rough successes refute strict precision necessity across these configurations.
tests.limits: No full 1975 narrative; no proof of contact non-necessity or precision sufficiency from these observations.

tests.topic: Tae Rak disabling and partial restoration
tests.rival_result: Rainfall and other changes remain; the negotiated setting and named excluded complex prevent an all-restored-output inference.
tests.surviving_inference: Documented local rights/hydraulic contribution and prospective partial reach.
tests.limits: Shared project lineage; no original opposition letters, engineering time series or catch/welfare estimate.

tests.topic: Martu governance and nonrandom fire-regime comparison
tests.rival_result: Environment/track selection and untested between-regime slope differences remain. Burn-age validation is not ignition validation.
tests.surviving_inference: Contemporary observed patterns and a described governance arrangement.
tests.limits: No causal biodiversity/welfare effect; overlapping study programme; no ancient/pan-Australian generalization.

tests.topic: Incumbents, later cohorts, entry and value capture
tests.rival_result: Selective linkage, local demand, gendered access, tools/customers and unpaid training prevent a universal transition claim.
tests.surviving_inference: Different populations have different measured outcomes; useful work is distinct from entry and remuneration.
tests.limits: No raw-data replication or representative apprentice returns. Five future-role candidates screened, not validated against contemporary market data.

findings.title: Keep necessity, sufficiency and an unresolved configuration rival separate
evidence: METHODS_ADDENDUM_V2: if both accounts predict evidence, say underdetermined
findings.problem: Compressed synthesis wording flips or combines the directions of two counterexamples. SKL-K17 also labels a contrast evaluated although its declared configuration-specific rival predicts the same observation.
supported_directions: Rough-component successes reject universal necessity of the stated strict machining demand across these examples.
unestablished_directions: Universal non-necessity of contact is not observed by merely allowing possible written-only success.
Precision sufficiency is not tested by rough-component success.
acceptance_criteria: Separate the two supported logical directions.
State the opposite directions are not established by these observations.
Replace precision-solving prose with the observed cross-lab contrast.
Mark the configuration-specific SKL-K17 comparison underdetermined, or explicitly segregate categorical rejection from unresolved local attribution.
Preserve the factual observations and partial1975 access; align canonical claims/specs, prose and compiled exports.
